styles.name: Trend Rider
styles.what: Follows the long-term daily trend. It only buys when Bitcoin is up over 20, 60 and 120 days and above its 50-day average (sells short in the mirror case), and holds for days to weeks.
styles.says: Every trend measure points up: it would only buy.

styles.name: Range Trader
styles.what: In sideways markets, buys a dip below the 4-hour likely range once price closes back inside it (sells the mirror at the top) and aims for the middle of the range.
styles.says: The market is trend up, and Range Trader only trades sideways markets.

checklist.label: Dipped below the range and closed back inside (buy)
Rose above the range and closed back inside (sell)

styles.name: Breakout Hunter
styles.what: After a quiet spell, waits for a 15-minute close beyond the last 20 candles’ high or low on at least double the usual volume, then waits for a retest instead of chasing.
styles.says: The market is not quiet (hourly volatility at its 81% level of 30 days); it waits for a squeeze.

checklist.label: Quiet spell in the last 4 hours (1h volatility in its lowest 20%)

styles.name: Funding Collector
styles.what: Does not bet on direction: holds Bitcoin plus an equal short future and collects the funding that leveraged buyers pay sellers every 8 hours, while that funding is positive.
styles.says: Funding is positive (about +15.6% a year), so the hedge would be earning it now.

styles.name: Master Bot (trend-led)
styles.what: The last trading bot: the daily trend (Trend Rider) decides the direction, and Range Trader, Breakout Hunter, a rulebook setup or price at support/resistance decides the moment.

history.verdict: Failed the pass rule (rules chosen after seeing results)

styles.says: The trend allows it to buy; it waits for another strategy or support to time the entry.

playbooks.name: Flush rebound
playbooks.what: A violent dump that closes positions (open interest falls) into support, then buyers take over.

trigger.wakes: a sharp drop or a burst of long liquidations

checklist.label: Market type is Range / Trend Up / Trend Down / High Vol
Open interest change during the trigger ≤ -0.005
Lower wick share of the 15m candle ≥ 0.4

versions.stop_target: stop 0.25 ATR beyond the trigger low; time limit 12 h
